title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The primary aim of the 'Provision of all-purpose safe drinking water to 36,050 vulnerable individuals, IDPs and host communities in Gaza City' Acute Crisis Response was to ensure access to safe drinking water for 36,050 vulnerable individuals, including IDPs and host communities. Oxfam and its partner Coastal Municipalities Water Utilities (CMWU) achieves this objective through delivery of safe water benefiting 5,150 IDPs and repairing and maintaining 5 water wells accessed by 32,000 individuals in Gaza City.. OUTCOME: Objective/Outcome 1: Save lives and facilitate improved access to critical basic water supply services to 36,050 internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) and conflict-affected households in the Gaza Strip through the safe provision of water supply services. .
